title: Sign-up by e-mail address, with a criterion met in unchanged code

pr.title: Sign-up and sign-in by e-mail address
pr.description: Adds the sign-up and the account lookup of the sign-in link for the new account page.

task:
Store e-mail addresses in lower case.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Sign-up stores the e-mail address in lower case.
2. Sign-in finds the account for any case of the address.

traps.why: Both criteria are met in unchanged code: UserRepo.insert() stores canonicalEmail(u.email), which is in lower case, and findByEmail() also calls canonicalEmail() (repo.ts, email.ts). A finding that the change stores the address as typed, or that sign-in is case-sensitive, is wrong.
